content: Kyaamwe, mwiisaaro eyo kukarorekana ekyeerekenio kyo okuruguurya bhukongʼu. Kwaari no omukari wuno yiibhohiibhwe eryoobha, no omweeri gwaari iyaasi wa amaguru gaaye. Kweeki, yaari yiibhohiri orusuurya rwe eziinzota ikumi ni ibhiri kumutwe gwaaye.
Omukari wuyo, yaari aritohiri, na akiigwa obhusuungu akarira hano yaari akwiibhura.

Kyaamwe, mwiisaaro eyo kukarorekana ekyeerekenio ekiindi kyo okuruguurya. Nikarora! Oguzoka ogukuru gukaangaaru gukatuuka gwaari ne emitwe muhuungati ne eziiheembe ikumi, ne emitwe gyoosi gyaari ne eziisuurya.
Omukira gwo oguzoka guyo gukakurura eyimwe ya katatu ye eziinzota ekazitaasa kukyaaro. Oguzoka gukiimeerera embere wo omukari wuno yaari kweenda kwiibhura, okubha hano ariibhure gurye omwaana.
Kyaamwe, omukari wuyo akiibhura omwaana we ekisubhe, wuno araakaangate ekyaaro kyoosi kwo obhunagya obhukuru.
Hano oguzoka gwaari kweenda okumurya, omwaana wuyo akasaakurwa, akahirwa ku Taatabhugya kukituumbi kyaaye kyo omuriinga.
Omukari wuyo akaryaarira mwiitirigo, ahagiro hano Taatabhugya yaari amubhanuriiri okubha amutuge eyo kwe eziisiku ekikwe kimwe magana abhiri na miroongo esaasabha (1,260).
Niho kukatuuka eriihi mwiisaaro. Maraika omukuru, wuno akubhirikirwa Mikaeri, hamwe na bhamaraika bhaaye, bhakiitana no oguzoka na bhamaraika bhaaye.
Nawe oguzoka na bhamaraika bhaaye bhakahizwa no okuheebhwa okurwa mwiisaaro.

Oguzoka gukarekerwa mukyaaro. Yino niyo enzoka ye ekare yino ekubhirikirwa Ibirisi kasi Seetaani, wuno akungʼeena abhaatu bhoosi bhakore ebhibhi. Eheene gukarekerwa mukyaaro hamwe na bhamaraika bhaaye.
Kyaamwe, nikiigwa eriiraka ikuru okurwa mwiisaaro rirabhuga,

content.text: ne eziinguru no obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya weetu,
Kwo okubha omuzoongeri wa abhiikirirya abharikyeetu arekeerwe haasi.
Na yaari embere wa Taatabhugya okubhahaya abharikyeetu obhutiku no omwiisi.
Nabho bhamuhiziri Seetaani kwa amanyiinga ge Engʼoondu ya Taatabhugya,
na kwe engʼana yo obhumeenyekererya bhuno bhakabhuruusya.
emwe bhamaraika bhoosi bhano mukwiikaramwiisaaro eyo!
Nawe, muraaza kurora bhano mukwiikara mukyaaro na munyaanza,
kwo okubha Seetaani yiituumiibhwe gati weenyu.
Ano obhururu bhukongʼu, kwo okubha amenyiri eziisiku zyaaye zisaagiri suuhu.”

content: Hano oguzoka gukarora gurekeerwe mukyaaro, gukamutuniirira omukari wurya wuno yaari yiibhwiiri omwaana we ekisubhe.

Nawe, Taatabhugya akamuha omukari wuyo amabhabha abhiri kya ge eriitoonyi eriikuru, okubha abhururuke agye mwiitirigo kure no oguzoka. Hayo aratugwa kuziisiku ekikwe kimwe magana abhiri na miroongo esaasabha (1,260).
Oguzoka gukaruusya amaanzi maaru kye ekitaaro kurwa mumunwa gwaaye, okubha omukari wuyo agegwe na amaanzi gayo.
Nawe, ekyaaro kikamusakirya omukari, kwo okwiikuundukura kyo omunwa, kikamira amaanzi goosi okurwa mumunwa gwo oguzoka.

Oguzoka gukamutiindira bhukongʼu omukari wuyo, gukagya kwiitana na abhaana abhaandi bho omukari wuyo bhano bhaasaagiri. Abhaana bhayo, nibho bhano bhakwiigwa obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya no okugaamba iguru wa Yeesu.
Ambe, oguzoka gukiimeerera embarika we enyaanza.

footnotes.text: Obhunagya obhukuru, ku Kiyunaani ni hiimbo ye ekyooma.
